text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, seriously! This hurts so bad, 
getting injured pisses me off...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If I rest, I'll be the only one falling 
behind again... I'm gonna get left behind 
again...
choice_data_list:
Can you promise me you won't push yourself 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't care. When I say I'm going back, I'm 
going back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm not in the mood for a lecture.
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, the gap will only widen.
If it gets worse, the gap will only widen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it! I just have to rest, 
right? I'll rest!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you thanking me? Makes zero 
sense. I'm just doing this because I wanna 
win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she looked frustrated, Tosen Jordan 
stayed still and rested for me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I don't plan on overdoing it. Even 
I know full well about—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to help her as she groaned 
in pain. It seems her injury has gotten 
worse...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I don't plan on overdoing it. Even 
I know full well when to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah! That really hit the spot~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's that? You can't complain about 
muscle training, right? Am I a genius or 
what~?
choice_data_list:
I'll put together a strength training 
routine right away!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you get it. Make it a good one, okay? 
That's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan continued training 
without pushing herself too hard, and made 
a brilliant comeback!
